verdict.rationale: Gladia's evidence shows a transcription API, a pipe-friendly CLI, and third-party integration partners (Zapier, Make, n8n). It does not document any first-party automation, scheduling, or background-agent feature. The partner integrations are external tools, and the CLI and async API are developer building blocks rather than an automation capability of the product itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
